// diagnostic E2126

Jet.PerfNoInstructions

`{trace}` keeps no instruction samples{scope}

What

`{trace}` keeps no instruction samples{scope}

Why

The instruction view lists the code a native run's samples landed in, which `jet perf run` keeps in the trace as it records; a trace that keeps none of it, or none of the named function or line, has nothing to list.

Fix

Profile the program natively with `jet perf run -O2 <file.jet>`, then view its trace with `--instructions`.
